part.text:
Migrated the entire Pages Router setup to the App Router with typed server components, route handlers, and App Router metadata. The global layout and provider moved into `app/layout.tsx`, and all pages/API endpoints are now implemented via App Router patterns with typed data models.

Changes made
- Built the App Router structure and migrated layouts/pages to `app/layout.tsx`, `app/page.tsx`, `app/blog/page.tsx`, and `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`
- Replaced Pages API routes with App Router handlers in `app/api/posts/route.ts` and `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts`
- Added typed 404 and error boundaries via `app/not-found.tsx` and `app/error.tsx`
- Converted the context provider to a typed client component in `components/AppProvider.tsx`
- Added a typed back button client component in `components/BackButton.tsx`
- Added shared types in `lib/types.ts` and updated styling for link-buttons in `styles/globals.css`
- Removed the `pages` directory entirely

Notes on App Router replacements
- `getServerSideProps` → server component with `dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` + `headers()` in `app/page.tsx`
- `getStaticProps`/ISR → `revalidate` + cached fetch in `app/blog/page.tsx`
- `getStaticPaths` + fallback → `generateStaticParams` + `dynamicParams = true` in `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`
- `next/head` → `metadata`/`generateMetadata` in App Router pages

Files touched
- `app/layout.tsx`
- `app/page.tsx`
- `app/blog/page.tsx`
- `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx`
- `app/not-found.tsx`
- `app/error.tsx`
- `app/api/posts/route.ts`
- `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts`
- `components/AppProvider.tsx`
- `components/BackButton.tsx`
- `lib/types.ts`
- `styles/globals.css`

Next steps
1. Run `npm run dev` to verify routing and API endpoints.
2. If you want, I can add tests or adjust metadata/OpenGraph further.
